business_problem: Flora Food Group wanted to consolidate multiple analytics tools into a single, more efficient platform that is better optimized and more sustainable.
solution_summary: Flora Food Group built its Microsoft solution to improve enterprise data-platform modernization. Flora Food Group wanted to consolidate multiple analytics tools into a single, more efficient platform that is better optimized and more sustainable. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Microsoft OneLake held and organized governed data. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Flora Food Group. The governed Microsoft stack gave Flora Food Group a reusable foundation for data analytics, data platform while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. With the streamlined architecture and enhanced capabilities of Fabric, Flora Food Group can offer more detailed and timely insights to its customers, enhancing service delivery and customer satisfaction.
